reasoning_details.text:
I'm checking the call-off total for request Q: 30k, 40k and 10k add up to 80k, which holds as long as the ledger's recorded uncancelled call-offs are complete. The 90k figure doesn't match that sum. I'm also looking at the new-competition trigger, since the rule says exactly 80k should not trigger it, which conflicts with the idea that reaching 80k does.

I'm going through the remaining checks now. The P05 call-off belongs to framework FW-B, so it doesn't count toward FW-A's cumulative value, which makes that one contradicted. P06 has no merging rule specified, so it stays not established. P07 is supported by F03. For P08, the cumulative value is scoped to the current calendar quarter, so a call-off from the previous quarter falls outside it and is contradicted.
